dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures on the posterior-right are irregular ovoids and interlocking '8' shapes, defined by 2-5 pixel wide high-intensity white boundaries with sharp transitions to dark interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white clusters (1-3 pixels in diameter) located at the intersection points of the light perimeter lines across the lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper posterior-right surface form an obtuse triangle; a cluster of four smaller blobs lower on the flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, linear reddish-brown mark is present on the dark skin surface near the base of the visible rear flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: A continuous solid dark dorsal region provides a high-contrast boundary against the complex reticulated pattern of the flanks.
